        - paragraph: In simple English
        - heading "Understand Standardisation" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "Standardisation changes a value into a z-score by measuring distance from the mean in standard deviations. A useful rule is Z-score: z=(x-mu)/sigma. You can learn Standardisation by trying one small example instead of long theory."
        - paragraph: Subtract the mean, then divide by the standard deviation. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
        - paragraph: "In real life, test scores: Compare scores from different exams. Watch out: Subtracting the mean but not dividing by standard deviation. A z-score needs both centering and scaling."
